harassment_detection.base_prompt: Analyze this image for potential harassment or threatening behavior.
specific_behaviors: A man closely following a woman in a way that appears unwanted or intimidating
A man blocking a woman's path, preventing her from moving freely
Aggressive or threatening body language directed by a man toward a woman
A man cornering a woman against a wall, vehicle, or confined space
A man making unwanted physical contact with a woman (touching, grabbing, pulling, restraining)
A man standing too close to a woman in a way that invades her personal space without consent
A man persistently pursuing, trailing, or stalking a woman despite her attempts to move away
Groups of men surrounding or intimidating a lone woman
A man verbally harassing a woman with shouting, catcalling, or hostile gestures (if audio/gestures available)
Two or more men engaging in a physical fight (punching, kicking, wrestling, or striking each other)
One man aggressively pushing, shoving, or grabbing another man
Men showing hostile gestures toward each other (raised fists, threatening hand movements, or posturing to fight)
One man chasing or pursuing another man in an aggressive or violent manner
Multiple men ganging up to physically or verbally intimidate another man
analyze the body structure of the person to detect if the is some kind of harassment or threatening behavior
Any violent confrontation between men in public (street fights, brawls, assault-like scenarios)
harassment_detection.response_format: Respond with 'ALERT' if harassment detected, 'SAFE' if normal behavior. Then provide a brief explanation.
harassment_detection.context_instructions: Consider the environment, body language, spatial relationships, and overall scene context.
